column3: NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew; “El” is rendered “The Mighty One.”
“Our God comes and may He not be silent” is rendered as a wish, “May our God come and not keep silence.”
Close to the Hebrew; “My faithful ones” is rendered “My godly ones.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will warn you” is rendered “I will testify against you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “What is it to you” is rendered “What right have you.”
Close to the Hebrew; “your portion is with adulterers” is rendered “you associate with adulterers.”
Close to the Hebrew; “you give a fault” is rendered “You slander.”
Close to the Hebrew; “I will arrange before your eyes” is rendered “state the case in order before your eyes.”
Close to the Hebrew; “who sets a way” is rendered “who orders his way aright.”
